results.description:
Viper is the third book in the dangerously hot Phantom Ops series by bestselling author Samantha Wilde. A fast-paced, brother's best friend, protector romance.

He's the alpha who doesn't say no.

Covert mission? High-stakes targets? He's here for it.

But Paige Wall—that's one area he won't touch.

His best friend's sister is strictly off-limits. Paige is a line he refuses to cross… no matter how many times he's already crossed it in his head.

His affection for her has been buried deep for years . . . deeper than any classified op he's ever run.

But when Paige needs an urgent exfiltration and he's the only Phantom Ops operator in range, he jumps in with both feet.

A killer is close on her heels. Obsessed.

Viper is the only thing standing between her and a mad man—and he'll keep it that way.

She has it bad.

Diving makes Paige feel alive. Swimming with the exotic ocean creatures, suspended in the deep blue water, is like being on another planet.

In Florida to drown her troubles and to put distance between her and a man she can't have—she finds a new kind of trouble.

A deadly kind.

Out in the open ocean with no one around, she's faced with a twisted murderer.

Viper comes to her rescue, and suddenly the man she can't have is the only one she wants.

The killer is close, hunter her more strategically than the predators in the water she loves so much. As it turns out, she's far from safe.

And her heart? That's where things get dangerous.

Mission accepted.

No hesitation.

No backup.
